integrity: Analytic argument given in RESULT.md; the standalone checker provides finite regression evidence only. No external independent review has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Finite-N angular formula has an exponentially small but generally nonzero edge-length remainder; the limit is for each fixed nondegenerate polygon, not uniformly over degenerating polygons. Earlier work already provides local independent-corner Poisson techniques; absolute scholarly priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Exponential angular universality for perimeter loss of boundary-random polygons
